title: Substituent dependence of magnetic response in a fused pentalene pair
difficulty_reasons: A measured or calculated molecular response may not uniquely identify the proposed local attribution.
Selecting valid representations, response definitions and discriminating evidence is part of the research.

data.description: Complete neutral identities of the two substituted fused pentalenes, without magnetic targets or a prescribed probe scheme.

required_deliverables.description: Structured investigation with actual evidence, units, identities, conclusions and limits.
Readable scientific report with auditable artifact links.
